title: McKinsey's Inside the Strategy Room takes up financial gravity — 'Why do so many beloved companies lose their way after taking on outside capital or going public?'
summary: Inside the Strategy Room is McKinsey's strategy podcast, hosted by Sean Brown. Eric and McKinsey senior partner Ryan Davies worked through financial gravity and the governance that resists it, using Costco's origins as the case.
blockquote: Why do so many beloved companies lose their way after taking on outside capital or going public?
